summary_1line: Bhishma tells Yudhishthira a fable of a virtuous jackal wrongly accused by jealous ministers to illustrate the difficulty of judging true character.

image_candidates.scene_text: In a moonlit cremation ground, a solitary jackal sits among ashes and bones, refusing meat and living on fallen fruit.
A powerful tiger king respectfully bows before a humble jackal, offering him the post of minister in the forest court.
Jealous animal ministers secretly hide the king’s meat inside the jackal’s dwelling to frame him for theft.
